crossRefs.note: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold…
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

translations.web: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.
translations.bsb: They made pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and finely spun linen on the lower hem of the robe.
translations.kjv: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined
translations.asv: And they made upon the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
